result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues affect readability and polish: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and the bottom navigation is missing an Orders icon.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card truncates the restaurant name to 'Trattoria Piccol' and clips the right edge of the image, so content is cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal card carousels have consistent peek/padding, use ellipsis or full wrapping for long names, and keep card content fully within safe margins.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows labels for Home, Search, Orders, and Profile, but the Orders tab has no icon while the others do.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. receipt/bag) and align icon+label styling with the other tabs.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right; 'Healthy' is only partly visible and a following chip is cut off, with no clear affordance that the list scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding/fade or a visible scroll cue so users know more categories exist, and avoid cutting chip labels mid-text.

issues.description: Promo copy is dense and slightly hard to scan: 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' sits in one long line on the green banner.
issues.suggestion: Break the secondary line or increase spacing/contrast so the code and minimum order read more clearly.
